evidence: Historical first-pass source finalsource/be/src/modules/account/account.controller.ts:135-162 protected PUT :id, parsed the identifier, and passed only the JWT-derived userId to AccountService.update.
Historical first-pass source finalsource/be/src/modules/account/account.service.ts:263-277 returned HTTP 404 for a missing account and HTTP 403 for a foreign-owned account before field mutation.
Targeted account-module ESLint and the Nest production build passed during first-pass verification.
requirements.rationale: Existence and ownership were enforced at the backend trust boundary before mutation or persistence.

evidence: Historical first-pass UpdateAccountDto applied IsEnum(AccountType).
Historical first-pass AccountEditForm defined exactly the five frozen account-type literals and rejected other values.
Backend and frontend production builds passed.
requirements.rationale: Frontend and authoritative backend validation used the same frozen account-type domain.

evidence: Historical first-pass UpdateAccountDto required nonblank bank_name and account_number_full.
Historical first-pass AccountEditForm rejected blank bank name and invalid or blank account number before submission.
Targeted backend lint and full frontend lint passed.
requirements.rationale: Required text fields were validated before submission and again at the backend trust boundary.

evidence: Historical first-pass UpdateAccountDto enforced the complete 8-34 digit pattern.
Historical first-pass AccountEditForm applied the same pattern and associated its error with the input.
The frozen-design account-number instruction was rendered verbatim.
requirements.rationale: Non-digit, too-short, and too-long values were rejected by both validation layers.

evidence: Historical first-pass UpdateAccountDto checked only that balance was a finite number and had no minimum-zero validation.
Historical first-pass AccountEditForm rejected missing and non-finite values but accepted a finite negative number.
The frontend converted the accepted balance to a numeric JSON value.
requirements.rationale: Numeric typing was enforced, but the frozen BR additionally required balance >= 0 at frontend and backend layers.

evidence: Historical first-pass AccountEditForm mapped a cleared branch to null.
Historical first-pass UpdateAccountDto accepted omitted/null branch input and AccountService stored blank or omitted input as null.
The existing Account.branchName column remained nullable; no schema change was made.
requirements.rationale: The optional branch could be cleared and was normalized to the established nullable persistence mapping.

evidence: Historical first-pass UpdateAccountRequest omitted account_number_last_4.
Historical first-pass UpdateAccountDto exposed no client-supplied last-four field.
Historical first-pass AccountService derived the last four characters with slice(-4).
requirements.rationale: The client could not submit the derived field and the backend derived the exact final four characters.

evidence: Historical first-pass AccountService mapped bank name, type, nullable branch, full number, derived last four, and balance onto the selected owned entity.
It performed one repository save, mapped the persisted response, translated uniqueness races to the established conflict convention, and used the required safe storage-failure message.
Validation, existence, ownership, and explicit uniqueness checks occurred before save; targeted backend lint and the Nest production build passed.
requirements.rationale: The update mapped the specified fields exactly and used a single database save with safe failure handling.
